repo.description:
Rocket.Chat's Apple Sign-In handler verifies JWT signatures but skips claims validation. Any Apple-signed JWT with a non-empty `iss` is accepted regardless of `aud`, `exp`, `nbf`, or `nonce`. An attacker who obtains a target user's Apple identity token (from server logs, an intercepted sign-in flow, or another application sharing the same Apple developer team) can replay it to authenticate as that user, with no expiration on the replay window.

## The defect

The signature verification and claims handling both live in `apps/meteor/app/apple/lib/handleIdentityToken.ts`.

Line 24:

​```ts
return KJUR.jws.JWS.verify(identityToken, userKey, ['RS256']);
​```

The jsrsasign API exposes two distinct functions: `JWS.verify` validates the signature only, and `JWS.verifyJWT` validates signature plus claims (`iss`, `aud`, `exp`, `nbf`). This handler uses `JWS.verify`.

Lines 41-42, after the decoded payload is parsed:

​```ts
const { iss, sub } = decodedToken.payloadObj as any;
if (!iss) {
​```

This is the only post-verification claim check. `iss` is asserted truthy but is never compared against `https://appleid.apple.com`. There is no `aud` check, no `exp` check, no `nbf` check, and no `nonce` binding anywhere in the function.

Line 48 spreads the entire decoded payload into `serviceData`:

​```ts
...decodedToken.payloadObj,
​```

and the function returns `serviceData` at line 51.

Three call sites consume the result and pass it to `Accounts.updateOrCreateUserFromExternalService`:

- `apps/meteor/app/apple/server/loginHandler.ts:19` (primary login flow), reaching `Accounts.updateOrCreateUserFromExternalService('apple', serviceData, { profile })` at line 32.
- `apps/meteor/app/apple/server/AppleCustomOAuth.ts:19` (custom OAuth flow).
- `apps/meteor/app/apple/server/appleOauthRegisterService.ts:69` (profile-link flow), reaching `Accounts.updateOrCreateUserFromExternalService` at line 80.

No upstream layer enforces the missing claims.
repo.summary: Apple Sign-In skips JWT claims validation, allowing expired and cross-audience token replay
